name: profeluna-backend
description: API de cursos y resultados de evaluaciones — profeluna.ar

scripts.ci:sintaxis: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');function w(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?(e.name==='node_modules'?[]:w(d+'/'+e.name)):(e.name.endsWith('.js')?[d+'/'+e.name]:[]))}for(const f of ['server.js',...w('src'),...w('api'),...w('scripts')]){execSync('node --check '+f)}console.log('OK sintaxis')"
